replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
From my point of view I see no reason why Camelot could not be in rotations. Ill add it to my list to review.

Subdivision should be in rotations soon.

I think camp creeper should be revamped, it leads to really long matches, and we should see what we can do to make it play a littler faster.

Former maps like Monster Bash / Grotto Arena may not return.  This has to do with how Villagers are working.

Rotated out maps like : Scarecrow, Reverse, Old Forest, were voted on and voted to be rotated out for now, they may return at some point, I don't have an ETA.
